title: Sources: ByteDance is discussing capex of up to $70B in 2026 as it builds out data centers and AI infrastructure, underwriting it with its $50B profit from 2025 (Bloomberg)
commentary: ByteDance spending $70B on AI infrastructure — more than Microsoft's entire 2025 capex — and funding it entirely from profit is the clearest signal yet that TikTok's parent is a different category of competitor than anyone in the West is treating it as.
